0022600092.text: Both the Portland Trail Blazers and the Phoenix Suns are opening their 2026-27 seasons, and Portland is at home, where ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Trail Blazers a 60% chance to win. Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery), while Chris Youngblood (calf soreness), Jrue Holiday (hand soreness), Micah Potter (illness), and Robert Williams III (rest) are listed as day-to-day. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), and Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (rest) are listed as day-to-day. The Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, but they won their most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026.
